question: Select the sentence that has the correct use of words and spellings from the options given below.

options.text: The delicius aroma of freshely baked cookies wafted through the kitchen, making mouths water.
The delicious arauma of freshely baked cookes wafted through the kitchen, making mouths water.
The delicious aroma of freshly baked cookies wafted through the kitchen, making mouths water.
The delicious arauma of freshly baked cookies waftad through the kitchen, making mouths water.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"delicious"** means highly pleasant to the taste. (स्वादिष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The **delicious** cake was the highlight of the party.
 
 
 
• **"Aroma"** refers to a distinctive, typically pleasant smell. (सुगंध)
 
 
• **Example: **The **aroma** of the flowers filled the room.
 
 
 
• **"Freshly"** means recently made, obtained, or arrived. (ताज़ा)
 
 
• **Example: **She picked** freshly **cut flowers from the garden.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is sentence with no spelling error is** "The delicious aroma of freshly baked cookies wafted through the kitchen, making mouths water."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The delicius aroma of freshely baked cookies wafted through the kitchen, making mouths water.

 
 
• **Delicius** (स्वादिष्ट): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is **"delicious".**
 
• **Freshely** (ताज़ा): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is "freshly".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The delicious arauma of **freshely** baked cookes wafted through the kitchen, making mouths water.
 
 
• **Arauma** (सुगंध): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is** "aroma".**
 
• **Freshely** (ताज़ा): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is **"freshly".**
 
• **Cookes** (कुकीज़): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is **"cookies".**
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The delicious arauma of freshly baked cookies waftad through the kitchen, making mouths water.
 
 
• **Arauma** (सुगंध): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is **"aroma".**
 
• **Waftad** (फैलाना): Incorrect spelling. Correct spelling is **"wafted".**
